description: This Flutter widget defines the DashboardScreen, which presents visualizations of expenses by category, including a pie chart and bar chart, utilizing provider for state management and custom painting for charts.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: StatelessWidget that displays expense visualizations including pie and bar charts.

classes.name: _PieChart
classes.description: Widget that renders a pie chart representing expense data.

classes.name: _PiePainter
classes.description: CustomPainter responsible for drawing the pie slices on the canvas.

classes.name: _BarChart
classes.description: Widget that renders a bar chart of expenses per category.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for DashboardScreen, assembling charts and UI components.

methods.name: _PiePainter.paint
methods.description: Renders the pie chart segments based on expense data.

methods.name: _PiePainter.shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines if the painter needs to repaint when data changes.

methods.name: _BarChart.build
methods.description: Constructs the bar chart visual for expense data.
